title: cs daily scratchpad - Acme QBR + renewals
content:
TODAY / QUICK NOTES:
- Morning: triage support ticket #CS-4821 (tokenization issue for Acme). Miguel to push patch to staging and confirm logs.
- 1:1 with Priya at 3pm — go over renewal pricing ask and latest usage numbers.
- Reminder: Acme QBR scheduled 2026-06-02 10:00 PT (60m). Need slides + one-pager by 2026-05-31.

ACME CORP — CURRENT STATUS (scratchy)
- Renewal date: 2026-07-15 (notice window 30d)
- Current ARR: $210k/yr (hosted + dedicated)
- Health: green overall. 2 incidents in last 90d: one infra (resolved), one performance regression (still investigating).
- Key contacts: Sarah Kim (CTO), Daniel Park (Infra), Nina Patel (ML platform).
- Usage: avg tokens/day +15% MoM; spikier during batch jobs on Tue/Thu.

OPEN ACTIONS FOR QBR
- Slides: baseline (me) — outline + usage trends + cost-savings opportunities + roadmap alignment
  - Due 2026-05-31 EOD (target for internal review)
- Demo: Jordan to get short demo of new caching feature (2 min clip) — due 2026-05-29
- Billing reconciliation: Priya to confirm outstanding invoice INV-998 and confirm payment timeline — check with finance by 2026-05-28
- Performance/regression: Miguel to share RCA draft on perf regression + mitigation plan (KV cache tuning) — draft by 2026-05-28
- Ask for the customer: align on expected peak concurrency to propose Dedicated sizing + burst plan

NOTES / THINGS TO CALL OUT IN QBR
- Show token-level cost breakdown (Console screenshot) — highlight savings from prefix caching and batch sizing
- Proposed commitment tiers: 3-level (baseline, peak, burst) with example unit economics
- Risk: if not upgraded to Dedicated, potential latency SLO misses during Black Friday style load — show simulation numbers

RENEWAL / UPSALE OPPS
- Opportunity: move Acme from hosted-heavy to hybrid dedicated for 20% cost savings and better latency guarantees. Potential +$60k ARR.
- Conversation owner: Priya + sales engineer (loop in Jordan for demo + perf numbers).

SUPPORT FOLLOW-UPS (tickets)
- CS-4821 (tokenization edge case) — in progress. Steps: reproduce internally -> patch -> verify w/ customer. Miguel assigned.
- CS-4799 (streaming timeouts) — monitored, workaround in place (retries). Schedule follow-up with Daniel next week.

MEETING PREP CHECKLIST
- Internal dry-run: 2026-05-30 11:00 PT (30m). Attendees: Erin, Priya, Miguel, Jordan
- Slide deck: 8-10 slides. Intro (2), Usage + trends (2), Cost breakdown (1), Roadmap alignment (1), Ask + next steps (1-2)
- Export Console screenshots, attach graphs: tokens/day, p50/p95 latency, model mix, cost per token
- One-pager: executive summary (1 page) for Sarah

NOTES TO SELF (scratchpad style)
- Check Confluence QBR template for standard metrics to include: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/QBR+templates
- Put billing screenshot in slide 4 (Priya will approve phrasing)
- Consider adding a short customer quote about stability improvements — ask CS rep for any notes from recent syncs

RISKS & DECISIONS NEEDED
- Decision: push for 12-month commit vs 6-month trial — need input from sales on discount structure.
- Risk: Outstanding invoice INV-998 might delay negotiation. Have finance escalate if needed.

QUICK TODO (today)
- [ ] Ping Miguel for patch status (by 11:00 PT)
- [ ] Draft QBR slide skeleton (by 5pm)
- [ ] Schedule dry-run invite (calendar)
- [ ] Confirm INV-998 payment ETA with Priya

END OF SCRATCHPAD (will flesh out into slides tomorrow)
